$comment: Compliance configuration for the CRYPTO sweep (config/social-compliance.json is the stock one). Selected with SOCIAL_COMPLIANCE_CONFIG=config/social-compliance-crypto.json. Legal/compliance may edit this file without a code change.
cardDisclosure: Educational market analysis only. Not investment advice. Trading involves risk.
$cardDisclosure: Printed on every crypto card (and in its alt text). The in-post `disclosure` is the short line because @GameSol404 has no X Premium: posts are capped at 280 characters and the full line alone is 79 of them.
$disclosurePlacementCrypto: Crypto posts go out from @GameSol404 (GameKing) since 2026-09-11. That account has no bio disclosure, so the full disclosure is carried in every crypto post (and still on every card).
$disclosurePlacement: 'post' = the disclosure line is appended to every post and validated; 'bio' = it lives in the account bio only (set it there!) and posts carry the required hashtags (#NFA #DYOR) as the in-post marker. Flip to 'post' to restore per-post disclosures without a code change.
$charLimit: 280 since 2026-09-11: @GameSol404 has no X Premium (no long posts). Every crypto generator fits to this with its fit ladder; the card carries the detail.
$marketHolidays: Empty by design: a 24/7 market has no full-day closures. Kept as a field so a venue-wide outage date can be added if one ever needs to be skipped.

autoPublish.$comment: Guard-railed unattended publishing (tv social auto). candidateSource 'report-cohort' posts exactly the names the report lists under Calls and Puts (its flow-trend gate is the authority; the classifier only supplies the label and can never upgrade one). Every guard below must hold; nothing here can override the stale-data gate. SOCIAL_AUTO_PUBLISH=0 in the environment is a kill switch. Crypto sweep: the weekend/holiday gates do not apply (marketCalendar 24x7); every other guard is identical to the stock policy.
autoPublish.$via: 'api' = publish through the X API from this machine; 'browser' = prepare and approve only (status ready_to_post) and let the scheduled Claude task post them through the logged-in Chrome, then `tv social record` marks them published.
autoPublish.$maxPostsPerRun: Publishing strategy: ONE highest-quality setup per run. Candidates are ranked by quality (candidateOrder) and the first that clears every guard is posted; nothing is forced when none does.
autoPublish.$candidateOrder: "quality" ranks the report cohort by the classifier: CONFIRMED before WATCH, then confidence, then |score|; ties broken by historical engagement for that setup type (docs/social/insights.json, tv social metrics report), then symbol. "report" keeps cohort order.
autoPublish.$minConfidence: The quality threshold. A Low-confidence read is never the day’s post, even if it is the only candidate — the run then publishes nothing.
autoPublish.$skipTracked: A symbol with an open lifecycle record (DEVELOPING/CONFIRMED) is never re-posted as a new setup; its follow-ups cover it until it resolves.

hashtags.$tagLine: Setup-family posts (setup, thread reply, follow-up, close check) end on exactly this line; the ticker appears in the text as $TICKER, not as a hashtag. Compliance blocks a setup-family post that does not end on it (hashtag_line). Remove tagLine (or empty it) to fall back to symbolTag + assetTag.
hashtags.$tagLineCrypto: Crypto account (@GameSol404) since 2026-09-11: #Crypto leads (the account's audience) and the line is 10 characters shorter than #TechnicalAnalysis #TradingEducation, which matters at 280.
hashtags.$comment: Sweep format: the fixed tagLine above (was: the cashtag as a hashtag plus one asset-class tag). No required marker tags: the disclosure lives in the bio AND on every chart, which is why charts.requireForPublish must be true (config loader enforces it). Put #NFA #DYOR back in required to restore the in-post marker.

cta.text: Which level gets hit first — {level1} or {level2}? 👇

charts.$comment: Sweep chart card (scripts/render-chart-sweep.py): near-square, mobile-first. requireForPublish=true is REQUIRED while hashtags.required is empty — the chart carries the only in-post disclaimer, so a render failure blocks the post rather than publishing it unmarked.
charts.$volumeLine: Adds 'Volume: 1.4× 20-day avg' to the post from the chart's candle data (integrity-checked against the chart).

$charLimit: X Premium account: long posts allowed. Set 280 for a non-Premium account (the fit ladder trims CTA → extra hashtags → narrative → …).
$marketCalendar: 24x7 disables the weekend and exchange-holiday refusals in auto-publish. Crypto never closes, so a Saturday report is a real session, not a re-show of Friday. Set nyse to restore exchange gating.
$queue: Tags every draft so `tv social ready --queue crypto` returns only this sweep. The stock poster asks for --queue stocks and can never pick these up.
$assetClass: Chart candles are fetched as a Yahoo pair (BTC -> BTC-USD) instead of an equity ticker.
$priceGrouping: Thousands separators, so BTC reads $79,610.00. Off for stocks, which keeps their post formatting byte-identical.
$plainLanguage: true adds the one-sentence "In plain terms:" reading of the setup (src/social/sweep-labels.js) under the indicator line. Off since 2026-09-11: it restated the chart card's subtitle, and the caption now leaves the details to the card (hook, interpretation, levels, question only).
$postFormat: "sweep" = the Daily Setup Sweep layout (headline verb, two levels, RVOL/score line, level-question CTA, 0-2 hashtags). "classic" restores the previous multi-line layout without a code change.
$priceDisplay: "compact" shows whole dollars once a price is in the thousands ($2,579). Compliance accepts any value a report level rounds to at the precision shown. "exact" keeps full precision.

brand.name: GameKing
brand.$seriesLine: Recurring-format footer on every setup post (before the Data line). Set to null to drop it.

$cta: Engagement line before the Data line; dropped first when the post does not fit. {level1} = the 🎯 level, {level2} = the 🛑 level. With only one level the generator asks a single-level question instead.

followUps.$comment: Event-driven follow-ups (tv social track), detected on DAILY CLOSES only: a close beyond the 🎯 level = BREAKOUT UPDATE, beyond the 🛑 level = INVALIDATED, an intraday touch of 🎯 without a close beyond = LEVEL TEST (postLevelTests), a later report confirming a DEVELOPING setup = CONFIRMED update. After maxAgeSessions bars without resolution the setup EXPIRES quietly (no post, not scored).
followUps.$maxUpdatesPerRun: Cap on non-terminal follow-ups (LEVEL TEST, CONFIRMED update) per run so a busy morning does not flood the feed. BREAKOUT and INVALIDATED updates always post — they are the accountability record.
followUps.$maxEventAgeHours: Freshness window for follow-ups, replacing maxReportAgeHours for kind=followup. A follow-up is dated by the daily bar that triggered it and the next run after a Friday close is Monday morning (65h; ~90h over a holiday weekend), so 96h. Older events are still audited as skipped, never back-posted.

scorecard.$comment: Weekly Setup Scorecard (tv social scorecard): counts ONLY the crypto queue. Disabled for now — enable it if @GameSol404 should post its own Friday scorecard; it will never include stock setups.

video.$library: "crypto" = src/social/crypto-video.js (networks, consensus, scaling, narratives such as restaking, RWA, DePIN, ZK, intents, AI agents), drawn as diagrams. Rotation, the once-a-day guard and the day counter are per queue, so this never collides with the stock chart videos. Enabled 2026-09-11 for @GameSol404, daily 6 AM via the post-crypto-education-video task.
video.cta: Save this • Follow for daily crypto education
video.endLine: Every day · one network · one idea
video.$comment: Daily Technical Analysis Education Video (tv social video), every day via the post-daily-chart-video task. One non-repeating topic per day from src/social/video.js: 1-2 s hook, animated chart with levels/arrows/captions, What it means / How traders use it, end card 'Save this • Follow for daily chart education', footer on every frame. Text carries no ticker (compliance kind video). Only one config should have this enabled.

education.$comment: Educational explainer posts (tv social educate), Tuesday and Friday 8 AM via the post-education-explainer task. One topic per post from src/social/education.js, rotated so the curriculum cycles, published as a numbered 'AI Trade School' lesson. The card is 1080x1350 (Instagram 4:5) with the footer text above; the text carries no ticker (compliance blocks one) and ends on exactly the two tags above. Disabled here — only the stocks config runs the explainers.

cryptoMarket.$comment: Daily crypto market read (tv social cryptomarket), queued by scripts/crypto-social-auto.sh BEFORE the setup so the poster publishes the market context first and the setup 2 minutes later. Built from the nightly crypto sweep: tone (RISK-ON / MIXED / RISK-OFF from breadth above the 20-day basis + average score), BTC and ETH lines, BTC levels with what negates the read, money flow, leaders/laggards, CTA, short disclaimer, Data line, 0-2 hashtags. Compliance kind 'cryptomarket' re-checks tone, breadth and BTC levels against the report.
